kevin-ng: Heads up — customer ACME reports audit export to JSON failing with 403 on console. They say the UI preflight shows a schema validation error before download. Anyone seen this recently?
asha-s: 403 from UI preflight usually means RBAC or a validation step. Do we have logs from their org id?
kevin-ng: Attached the console error they copied: 
```
preflight_error: validation_failed
missing_field: event.actor_id
permissions_check: passed
http_status: 403
```
They also pasted the export request we send: `POST /api/audit/export?format=json&page_size=500` with body {filters...} and header `X-Org-ID: org-acme`
samir: Quick Q — is this the streaming export or the CSV backfill? UI switches validators between modes. If it's streaming, we don't do KMS decrypt on the fly. If it's backfill, we might be hitting decrypt for masked fields.
lisa-pm: Customer said they chose "Download JSON" from viewer (non-stream). So likely backend preflight that assembles sample events for validation.
elainE-security: FYI there was a recent schema PR that introduced `actor.identity` as an object instead of `actor_id` string (for richer identity). If preflight expects actor_id string it's going to fail.
kevin-ng: That matches — their payload includes `actor: { identity: { id: "usr_123", type: "service" }, ip: "1.2.3.4" }` while validator path was `event.actor_id`.
asha-s: Two things to consider: 1) validation should be schema tolerant — don't fail exports if unknown structure, instead warn. 2) RBAC: ensure `audit_viewer` role still allowed to request sample events.
devops-bot: build/validator-service 2024-08-03T14:22:11Z: validation-service v2.3 deployed (schema: audit-v2).
samir: validator-service v2.3 introduced strict mode by default. That might be the immediate cause. We flipped strict to catch regressions.
elainE-security: For customers we should gate strict mode behind a feature flag or only apply during CI, not console runtime.
lisa-pm: Can we short-term add a fallback path: if validation fails, return a 200 with a warning banner and allow download (maybe masked)? Product prefers permissive UX for downloads.
kevin-ng: Agree. But there's KMS implications: some fields are encrypted (PII). The export preflight decrypts a sample using customer KMS key to validate masking rules. If preflight fails due to KMS permission, we currently return 403.
asha-s: Do we have the exact KMS error from their run? Kept snippet: `kms:Decrypt denied for key projects/…/keys/acme-key - AccessDenied`
kevin-ng: Right — they use a service principal that lost grant to CloudKMS after recent infra changes. So two separate failure modes: schema mismatch and KMS deny.
product-analytics: Customer impact: inability to download audit exports blocks SOC investigations. Need a two-step mitigation plan.
samir: Proposed mitigations: 1) revert validator strict mode for console preflight (owner: samir, ETA: 2h) 2) add fallback download-with-warning path (owner: kevin-ng, ETA: 24h) 3) surface clearer errors for KMS denies vs validation (owner: ashA-s, ETA: 4h)
elainE-security: Also need longer-term: migration guide for schema v2, update console validators to accept either `actor_id` or `actor.identity.id` and update docs for export consumers. (owner: elaine-security)
lisa-pm: UX detail: when fallback happens show a modal: "Some events failed validation; download anyway?" with checkboxes to strip encrypted fields or include them if KMS check passed.
kevin-ng: Implementation note: backend export should attach `export_meta.validation_errors` array into the JSON bundle so customers can audit what was skipped.
asha-s: RBAC fix: add a permission `audit:export:bypass_validation` for support users only, not customer orgs. Avoid leaking for org-level roles.
samir: I'll flip strict->non-strict on validator-service and tag the deploy so we can rollback. Posting deploy link: https://ci.redwood/builds/validator-service/2345 :thumbsup:
kevin-ng: I'll open a support ticket template for orgs with KMS denies that lists steps to re-grant CloudKMS:Decrypt to our service principal and how to verify with `gcloud kms keys get-iam-policy`.
elainE-security: Also open a postmortem-style note for schema rollout practice — we should feature-flag schema changes and run tenant canaries.
product-analytics: pls add a short blurb we can send to ACME: explanation, immediate workaround (UI toggle), and next steps. I can draft it.
kevin-ng: OK action items: samir -> revert strict (2h), kevin -> fallback path & support ticket template (24h), asha -> better error messages (4h), elaine -> migration guide + docs (3d), lisa -> UX modal copy (1d), product-analytics -> customer blurb (today).
kevin-ng: I'll follow up in ~2h with status. Thanks team :pray:
